fixes: Reconcile the car's visual assembly with its physical body: the black roof/cargo slab floats and intersects the blue panels and the wheels read as detached from the silhouette (frame-003, frame-004), obscuring the visual front heading even though motion is now collision-safe.
Remove or gate the stray thin black diagonal line drawn across the pavement, visible in frame-000, frame-003 and frame-005; it reads as a leftover debug/line renderer rather than road paint.

Add camera occlusion/offset handling: at t=18.5 the chase camera is steep over the roof with the entire right half filled by a flat maroon wall, so the boundary the car is being driven into is barely readable.
Confirm the lane visually: in frame-003 the stopped car is riding tight against the curb/step edge rather than centered in the street, so verify spawn (3.6,0,8) and route keep it on the roadway.
Confirm from state trace (frames cannot show it) that Restarts incremented exactly once at R=24 and that health, visible player and Walker/CharacterController were re-enabled.
review.summary: Scoped evidence supports the collision-reset pass. frame-000 (t=3.2) shows the player grounded on foot at the start with empty pavement ahead; frame-003 (t=18.5, inside the held-W-into-boundary window) shows the blue car upright on its wheels pressed against the end of the street, consistent with native vehicle_stop_motion ~0.001 (physically stopped under held throttle, no runaway root translation); frame-004 (t=21.8, after E exit) shows the car parked upright with wheels on the ground beside the building and the player back on foot, confirming a grounded exit; frame-005 (t=25, after R) reproduces the pre-entry framing, indicating position/orientation/camera-follow were restored; frame-006 (t=31) shows the view displaced down the sidewalk with the reset car now partly visible at lower-left, confirming post-reset foot movement actually occurred. This matches scoped_facts (entered_before_throttle, grounded_exit_before_reset, vehicle_stop_motion ~0.00098, reset_positions_and_state) and the passing walk and world-collision regressions. Not establishable from frames: Restarts counter, health, CharacterController enable state, HUD/audio - those rest on the state trace alone. Remaining issues are visual polish, not blocked mechanics: the black roof box intersects the blue slab body with seemingly detached wheels (visual/physical mismatch), a stray black line is painted across the pavement in three frames, and the chase camera clips into the facade during the boundary stop.
